source.title: Updated approved valuation report template - minimum requirements
verifiedFacts: The official template states that the minimum requirements must be satisfied in valuation reports and do not replace other requirements arising from standards, professional rules, manuals, decisions, circulars or instructions.
The template references paragraph 16 of Article 28 of the Implementing Regulation as requiring adherence at minimum to the approved valuation-report and valuation-services-contract models.
The source requires the applicable edition of TAQEEM-adopted International Valuation Standards to be identified in the report.
The source separately identifies professional-content requirements and regulatory/identity/signature requirements.

sourceNumberingNote: The official PDF text extraction shows the label 21 for both principal inputs and value conclusion/reconciliation. STARTAK uses distinct internal requirement IDs while preserving each extracted source label rather than silently renumbering the official source.

requirements.gap: Credential validity and the accredited valuer identity required for external issuance are not externally verified.
clientPartyId exists in the assignment but is not persisted into the current professional report contract.
Intended-user party IDs exist upstream but are not persisted into the current report contract.
Property reference and evidence exist, but a complete human-readable asset identification/description section is not enforced by the report contract.
No mandatory valuation-currency field exists in the professional report contract.
Basis code is bound, but a human-readable definition and definition source are not enforced as a report section.
The report contract has assumptions and HBU evidence but no mandatory premise-of-value field.

requirements.titleAr: طبيعة عمل المقيم وأي قيود عليه
requirements.gap: Limitations are report-bound, but the complete performed scope of inspection, inquiry and analysis is not mandatory as a dedicated report section.

requirements.titleAr: طبيعة ومصدر المعلومات التي يعتمد عليها المقيم
requirements.gap: Evidence provenance exists, but the report contract does not require a narrative of verification procedures and actual research scope.
Specialist evidence can exist in assignment governance but is not mandatory in the report contract.
ESG evidence can be attached but report-level applicability/disclosure wording is not universally required.
Internal report type is explicit, but the presentation/delivery format required for a professional external report is not authorized or rendered.

requirements.titleAr: القيود على الاستخدام أو التوزيع أو النشر
requirements.gap: Reliance restrictions exist upstream but are not persisted as a mandatory report field.

requirements.titleAr: التأكيد على الإعداد وفق معايير التقييم الدولية وتحديد الإصدار
requirements.gap: The exact standards snapshot is reproducible, but formal TAQEEM/IVS conformance remains explicitly unestablished pending official/professional verification.
Method disposition and rationale exist; a separate approach-level taxonomy/disclosure is not enforced in the report contract.
Input provenance is available in upstream method packets/results, but a consolidated principal-input disclosure is not mandatory in the report contract.

requirements.titleAr: استنتاج القيمة والأسباب الرئيسة لأي نتيجة تم التوصل إليها
requirements.gap: The current report contract intentionally does not establish a final/certified valuation conclusion or external professional reconciliation.
Credential reference exists but license number/date validity and page-level rendering are not externally validated.
No accredited-valuer signature is captured or simulated; human licensed signature remains external.
No TAQEEM electronic-services deposit code is obtained or validated.
TAQEEM membership category is not externally verified or report-bound.

requirements.titleAr: نوع الفرع الذي رخص له المقيم مزاولة المهنة فيه
requirements.gap: Licensed valuation branch is not externally verified or report-bound.
Preparer/reviewer references exist but the complete participant roster, professional membership/certificate type, contribution description and signatures are not modeled for external issuance.
Independent-review governance exists, but a valuer-specific independence disclosure against the subject asset is not a mandatory report field.

requiredNextActions: Extend the professional report contract to preserve client identity, intended users, currency, premise of value, use/distribution restrictions, specialist disclosure and consolidated principal inputs where applicable.
Add a controlled professional conclusion/reconciliation record only behind licensed professional authority and credential gates; do not derive a certified conclusion automatically.
Add external credential evidence for TAQEEM license number/date, membership category and licensed branch.
Add external participant roster/signature evidence and valuer independence disclosure.
Add TAQEEM deposit-code integration evidence only if/when an authorized professional workflow is established.
Re-run section-level conformance review after official-source/legal/professional approval; do not change conformance flags automatically.
